content_sections.heading: IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: The recruitment drive aims to fill a total of 3 vacancies in the research group of Dr. Vandana Sharma, Department of Physics, IIT Hyderabad.

content_sections.heading: IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: For Lab Support Engineer candidates from Computer Science and Engineering or Mechanical Engineering: Knowledge of machine learning and deep learning Experience with Python programming, image processing, data analysis, and data visualization Familiarity with databases and scientific data handling Experience in mechanical design and engineering drawing Familiarity with CAD tools and stress/structural simulations Experience in prototype development, fabrication, or instrumentation For JRF candidates from Optics/Photonics: Hands-on experience in optical alignment and laboratory optics Familiarity with optical simulation software Experience in data acquisition, image processing, and image analysis Experimental experience with cameras, lasers, optical components, or imaging systems Computational/Analytical Skills: Experience with one or more of the following is desirable: Python, MATLAB, LabVIEW, data acquisition, data analysis, data visualization, image processing, and scientific computing.

rows.qualification_required: M.Sc. in Physics/Optics/Photonics or a related specialization AND Valid GATE score or UGC/CSIR NET-JRF
B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering or B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering

faq.question: Q1. What is IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification by IIT Hyderabad to hire Junior Research Fellows and a Lab Support Engineer in the Department of Physics.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies are available, including 2 for Junior Research Fellow and 1 for Lab Support Engineer.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IIT Hyderabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving applications is 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.Sc. in Physics/Optics/Photonics or a related specialization along with a valid GATE score or UGC/CSIR NET-JRF.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for the Lab Support Engineer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering or B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering.
